topics.gist: Sellers create campaigns via `POST /shops/:shopId/ads/campaigns`; `GET /ads/sponsored` serves listings, and campaign daily spend is tracked in Redis against budgets. Modules wire serving and worker parts.
topics.title: Sponsored ad campaigns and serving

topics.gist: `GET /ads/click/:token` verifies HMAC-signed click tokens (`signClick`/`verifyClick`, 30-minute expiry), dedupes via Redis SET NX, applies per-IP burst limits, always redirects, and publishes salted clicks to Kafka.
topics.title: Ad click tokens and fraud checks

topics.gist: `ClickAggregator` writes per-minute aggregates with Kafka exactly-once transactions; `ads.bill-hour` charges hourly with ledger postings capped by budget, and `ads.reconcile-day` reconciles from raw clicks via `AdBillingRun`.
topics.title: Aggregating and billing ad clicks

topics.gist: `POST /links`, `GET /links` and `GET /l/:code` create, list and redirect short affiliate links. Codes come from a Feistel cipher over leased IDs, are stored in DynamoDB with Redis caching, and destinations are checked against open redirects.
topics.title: Creating and resolving share links

topics.gist: Redirects emit `LinkClicked` events to Kafka (`links.events`); `LinkClicksProjector` consumes `link.clicked` and inserts into the ClickHouse `link_clicks` table, deduplicated by click_id, serving `GET /links/:code/stats`.
topics.title: Link click attribution and stats

topics.gist: Consumes `payments.requests` from Kafka, runs `PaymentService` with idempotency keys and optimistic stock deduction, publishes results via outbox, routes failures to a DLQ, and refunds via saga if stock runs out.
topics.title: Charging a card through Stripe

topics.gist: The `Payment` Sequelize model with statuses (including `UNKNOWN`) and scopes, plus `PaymentDtoService` for CRUD and query access to payments.
topics.title: Payment records and DTO service

topics.gist: Double-entry bookkeeping in `LedgerService`: journals must sum to zero, entries are immutable `LedgerEntry` rows, and each posting emits `JournalPosted` through the outbox in the same transaction.
topics.title: Recording money in the ledger

topics.gist: `SettlementListener` reacts to `order.paid`, splits the net amount across shops by largest-remainder allocation, and posts the journal exactly once using a UUIDv5 journalId and an advisory lock.
topics.title: Settling paid orders to shops

topics.gist: `BalanceProjector` applies `ledger.journal_posted` events to Redis balances via a Lua script. `FinanceController` serves `GET /shops/:shopId/balance` and `/payouts`, falling back to the ledger.
topics.title: Shop balance and payout history reads

topics.gist: The `payouts.run-weekly` and `payouts.send` jobs create one `Payout` per shop per week, transfer through Stripe Connect, and reverse the ledger journal on definite failures.
topics.title: Weekly seller payouts

topics.gist: The `payments.resolve-unknown` job runs every 5 minutes, queries Stripe by idempotency key for `UNKNOWN` payments, settles them through the ledger, and gives up after 60 minutes.
topics.title: Resolving payments stuck in UNKNOWN

topics.gist: The `payments.reconcile-daily` job runs at 02:30 UTC, streams Stripe charges, compares them with the ledger by idempotency key, and records mismatches. It is idempotent per provider and day.
topics.title: Daily Stripe reconciliation

topics.gist: `LedgerMaintenanceJobs` runs `ledger.ensure-partitions` monthly to pre-create partitions and `ledger.verify-invariants` daily to check that the book and recent journals sum to zero.
topics.title: Ledger partitions and invariant checks
